title: Bring in ’Da Noise, Bring in ’Da Funk / Dancer

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Use type as an active part of the image because rhythm on a poster can echo the performance it announces.
strategic_value: The dancer surrounded by varied text can connect the production’s movement with The Public’s street-based graphic voice.
demonstration: A black-and-white dancer cuts across blue title lettering, red emphases and narrow angled review blocks on white.
practical_value: Compare changes of angle, width and scale as a typographic counterpart to a moving figure.

content_islands.name: Dancer and title
content_islands.spec: Place the figure across the large blue headline.

content_islands.name: Surrounding voices
content_islands.spec: Fit reviews, credits and booking information around the figure at varied angles.
